column7: RECOVERY-MFA-RESET-1: the online MFA reset and its audit rows are one fail-closed transaction (withAuditedMutation): with the audit write refused the approval returns ErrMutationAuditUnavailable, the target keeps its TOTP secret, recovery codes, session and password, and the request stays pending. Host-command sibling: ./server/admin TestPerformResetMFA_AuditOutage_LeavesMFAIntact.
